description: Find (and optionally replace) text across the entire document. Uses Text find/change, or GREP when useRegex is true.

replaceText.description: Replacement text. Omit to only find; pass "" to delete matches.

searchText.description: Text to search for (a GREP pattern when useRegex is true)

useRegex.description: Treat searchText as a GREP pattern (and replaceText may use $1 etc.)

name: find_text_in_document
title: Find Text In Document
